main_body: Market stall counter (brown wooden front with a striped awning and produce shelf above); the counter is the largest volume
top_band: light brown counter top at rows ~26-29, with produce sitting on it and a pinkish-orange highlight at row 28; below it the darker brown front face from row 30
evidence: The vertical column through the counter reads as a lighter top band (rows 26-29, partly covered by produce), then a peach highlight at the front edge (row 28), then a darker step at row 30 and a plank front face down to the stone base at row 42. The top is foreshortened and clearly more than a 1-2px rim, comparable to the reference stall counters. The front planks are painted flat with no inset, but the top band, edge line and shadow step are enough. The awning is a separate prop element.

style.evidence: The wood has about 4-5 steps (highlight, light, mid, dark, deep) with plank grain dots and seams. The awning has 3-4 greens plus a grey-white stripe. Outlines are a dark purple-brown that leans toward the neighbouring material, not neutral black. The produce is shaded in several tones. The large counter front is somewhat plain but still has grain speckle and knots. Overall it sits close to the stall references.
